Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. Provides Earnings Guidance for the Third Quarter Ending December 31, 2019 and Fiscal Year Ending March 31, 2020. Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. provided earnings guidance for the third quarter ending December 31, 2019 and fiscal year ending March 31, 2020. For the quarter, the company expects GAAP net revenue is the range from $915 to $965 million. GAAP net income is expected to range from $159 to $170 million. GAAP diluted net income per share is expected to range from $1.39 to $1.49.For the fiscal year ending March 31, 2020, GAAP net revenue is expected to range from $2.93 to $3.03 billion. GAAP net income is expected to range from $388 to $416 million. GAAP diluted net income per share is expected to range from $3.38 to $3.63.

Proletariat, Inc. announced that it has received $20 million in funding from Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc., Spark Capital Partners, LLC, FirstMark Capital, L.L.C., and other investors. On November 19, 2019, Proletariat, Inc. closed the transaction. The company raised $20,000,000 in its series C round of funding led by new investor Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NasdaqGS:TTWO). The transaction also involved participation from returning investors, Spark Capital Partners, LLC, FirstMark Capital, L.L.C. and other investors. As part of the transaction, Michael Worosz of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NasdaqGS:TTWO) will join the board of directors of the company. The company issued $19,720,233 pursuant to exemption provided under Regulation D from 5 investors.
